info.title: Confidential Inference Gateway Admin API
info.description: The gateway keeps no state on disk. The admin key registry is the only key store. The gateway pulls the key snapshot from the admin (GET /api/gateway/key-snapshot, served by the admin) and holds it in memory. The admin may also push the same snapshot to the gateway as a fast path. Every route under /admin/v1 is served by the gateway through c8s tls-lb and requires an admin API key or the v1 request signature.

200.description: The admin API runs. `status` tells whether the gateway holds a key snapshot.

get.description: Always 200 while the process runs. `status` is `ready` once the gateway holds a key snapshot.
Reports the revision of the snapshot the gateway holds, when it was last applied or confirmed, and the pepper fingerprint. The admin may read it as a drift probe.

put.summary: Push the key registry snapshot (fast path)
put.description: Optional fast path. The gateway also pulls the same snapshot from the admin (GET /api/gateway/key-snapshot) at startup and every 30 seconds. A push and a pull follow the same checks: schema, environment, revision rule, envelope and per-row pepper check, at most 10000 rows. The gateway applies a strictly higher revision, acknowledges an equal one, and refuses a lower one. It keeps the snapshot in memory only. The snapshot carries no signature of its own: the admin authentication of the request is the only check.

200.description: The gateway applied the snapshot, or it already held that revision.

servers.description: The admin origin: the origin of `endpoint` in the gateway's CDS secret /confidential-inference/gateway/product-usage. Its host is the TLS name the gateway checks.

get.summary: Pull the key registry snapshot (served by the admin)
get.description: The admin serves this route; the gateway calls it. The admin answers with the snapshot of the key realm and environment bound to the bearer token. The gateway pulls at startup, every 5 seconds until the first snapshot is applied, then every 30 seconds. It follows no redirect, reads at most 4 MiB, and, when the CDS secret sets `tls_ca_pem`, trusts only that CA. It applies the body like a push (same checks and revision rule). A failed pull keeps the snapshot the gateway already holds. Until the first snapshot is applied, the gateway's `/ready` answers 503 and inference answers 503 `key_registry_not_ready`.

200.description: The current snapshot of the token's key realm.

401.description: The bearer token is missing or matches no gateway binding (`unauthorized`).

503.description: The realm has no snapshot yet (`empty_registry`; a gateway never receives an empty key set), the admin has no gateway credentials configured (`gateway_credentials_disabled`), or the registry is unavailable (`registry_unavailable`).

adminApiKey.description: An admin API key. The gateway accepts a key whose lowercase hex SHA-256 is listed in the Kubernetes Secret `gateway-admin-api-key` (key `sha256`, one or two hashes, so a rotation can hold the old and the new key). A request with an Authorization header is judged by that header alone.

adminSignedRequest.name: X-Admin-Signature
adminSignedRequest.description: The v1 request signature: a P-256 signature over the method, path, body hash, timestamp, and one-time nonce. It stays until the admin cutover (confidential-inference#186).

gatewayBearerToken.description: The `token` of the gateway's CDS secret /confidential-inference/gateway/product-usage, 32 to 256 URL-safe characters. The admin maps it to one environment and key realm. The same token authenticates usage ingest (product-usage.md).

detail.description: Present for `pepper_mismatch`: the first 12 characters of each pepper fingerprint.

lastSuccessUnix.description: When a snapshot was last applied or its revision confirmed, by a pull or a push.

pepperFingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the pepper this gateway holds.

RegistrySourceStatus.description: The snapshot status of this gateway. `cachedRevision` is null until the first snapshot is applied.

owner.description: The customer or team that holds the key.

keyHash.description: Base64url, no padding, of HMAC-SHA256(pepper, plaintext). It never discloses the plaintext key or the pepper.

pepperFingerprint.description: Binds this hash to one pepper. The gateway skips and counts a row whose fingerprint differs from its own.

rateLimit.description: Reserved. Always null in this release. The gateway accepts and ignores it.

environment.description: The gateway refuses a snapshot that names another environment.

revision.description: The registry revision. The gateway applies a strictly higher revision, acknowledges an equal one, and refuses a lower one (`stale_revision`). A restarted gateway holds no revision and applies any revision of at least 1.

pepperFingerprint.description: The pepper the admin minted every row with. The gateway refuses the whole snapshot (`pepper_mismatch`) when it names another pepper. An empty value states nothing; each row is then judged by its own fingerprint.

cachedRevision.description: The revision the gateway holds after this push.

applied.description: False when the push repeated the cached revision: nothing changed, and the admin may treat this as an acknowledgement.

InvalidRequest.description: The snapshot is invalid (`invalid_request`): wrong schema version or environment, a revision below 1, more than 10000 rows, or a bad field value.

Unauthenticated.description: The admin API key or the request signature is missing or invalid.

Conflict.description: The snapshot revision is lower than the cached revision (`stale_revision`), or the snapshot envelope names a pepper this gateway does not hold (`pepper_mismatch`).
